note: Owner-created demo obligations only. A judge cannot create obligations (owner-only, see plan section 3.1.11), so the playground reads these pre-created obligations live from the contract and never invents state. The happy-path obligation on the test vault is consumed by the first correct settle; after that it demonstrates the replay case. The frozen case needs the owner to freeze the policy during the demo. The three Phase 9 proof obligations on production are read-only cases: the playground reads them live but never makes them settleable. The three Phase 10 demo obligations on the test vault are read-only cases: the playground reads them live but never makes them settleable; they are the demo video's happy path, attack, and TEE proof.
